title: Turn a Messy CSV into Usable Data
core_invariant: Data cleaning is an explicit, immutable pipeline of transformations preserving data integrity.

stages.title: Messy Sensor Dataset Overview
stages.instructions: Inspect raw telemetry data with missing values, corrupt timestamps, and negative readings.

stages.title: Mean vs Median Imputation Experiment
stages.instructions: Predict how mean vs median imputation affects standard deviation in the presence of heavy-tailed outliers.

stages.title: Diagnose Silent Type Conversion Bug
stages.instructions: A downstream model receives object dtypes instead of float32 due to string 'N/A' tokens. Fix the ingestion pipeline.

stages.title: No-AI Real Estate Cleaning Challenge
stages.instructions: Clean a fresh real estate dataset containing mixed currency strings and missing zip codes.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Zero missing values, all numerical columns typed correctly, zero data leakage.
